description: Osservatorio Sismico delle Strutture (OSS) - Versione 2.0 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by rischi.protezionecivile.gov.it. The OSS of the Civil Protection Department monitors in Italy the seismic response of public structures (schools, town halls, hospitals, bridges etc.) with 149 monitoring systems (127 complete wired with control unit and?20 accelerometers: 3 on the ground, =3 on the floor, and 22 simplified wireless: 6÷8 accelerometers: 3 on the ground, 3÷5 at the ... Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Seismic Observatory of Structures (OSS) — Version 2.0" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Structural damage assessment, Osservatorio Sismico delle Strutture, Seismic monitoring of structures, Monitoraggio sismico di strutture, Valutazione del danno strutturale, opendata. The listing shows 2014-06-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
